messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High token delta for customer 'Sierra Systems' (tenant: sierrasys-prod) on VPC ded-s-02 in us-west2. Token-per-request up ~18x vs baseline over the last 10m. Possible tokenizer/encoding mismatch. Paging on-call @mei.

mei (oncall): Ack. I see the alert, pulling logs + request samples now. I'll start with a tenant token histogram and recent model variants.

mei (oncall): Quick check — traffic is concentrated on route: /generate with model: redwood/gptj-compat-v3 and variant 'bpe-legacy' but token counts look like UTF-16 expansion. Sample payload below:  
```
{"input":"\u00ff... (binary-ish chars)"}
```

raj.suresh: Tagging in. If they switched SDK encoding to UTF-16 we'd see ~2x token inflation for most inputs, but 18x suggests mismatched tokenizer (e.g., treating byte offsets as codepoints). Can you paste a raw request body?

mei (oncall): Pasting raw (redacted):  
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood/gptj-compat-v3",
  "input": "\u200e\u200e...\"large blob\"..."
}
```

elena (eng-ml): I pulled the tokenization trace for that request id. Looks like the frontend SDK set header `X-encoding: utf-16le` but our tokenizer pipeline ignored it and ran u8-bpe. That causes byte sequences to be misinterpreted as many small tokens.

cs-liaison: Customer says they rolled out sierra-sdk@2.4.0 at 07:12 UTC, which included an encoding change. They reported increased token counts to their app and opened a ticket with CS. Asking for an ETA for mitigation — they are worried about billing.

sam (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigation options: 1) enforce per-tenant token cap for sierrasys-prod, 2) force-compatible tokenizer variant for their requests by routing to model variant 'bytepair-compat', or 3) temporarily enable aggressive prefix KV caching for known prompt patterns. Which do we want to push now?

mei (oncall): Do option 2 + 1. Route them to 'bytepair-compat' and set a conservative token ceiling. I'll enact the route and a soft limit so we don't immediately cut them off.

raj.suresh: I'll prepare a hotfix to the tokenizer compatibility layer to honor `X-encoding` header. Patch will be minor but needs a quick CI run.

mei (oncall): Applying routing rule now: 
```
# admin action: route sierrasys-prod -> bytepair-compat variant on ded-s-02
POST /internal/routing/set
{"tenant":"sierrasys-prod","target_variant":"bytepair-compat","reason":"tokenizer mismatch mitigation"}
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Routing change submitted by mei at 2026-03-15T21:34:50Z. Change id: rout-8f3c. Rolling to ded-s-02 nodes (3/3).

sam (eng-runtime): I confirmed config applied on all nodes in ded-s-02. New requests from sierrasys-prod now see variant=bytepair-compat. Token counts for recent 5m window dropped ~8x after the switch.

mei (oncall): Setting temporary soft cap: 
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/admin/tenants/sierrasys-prod/limits \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
 -d '{"max_tokens_per_min": 2500000, "mode":"soft"}'
```

ben (billing): Heads up — there's a billing alert triggered when tokens exceed tenant threshold. We've paused automatic invoices for the spike window pending root cause. Customer will get a note re: possible bill adjustment.

cs-liaison: I told customer we applied a routing fallback and a soft cap; we're investigating root cause and will follow up within 60m. They've provided the SDK change log that mentions `encoding` default change.

elena (eng-ml): Root cause: SDK changed to emit UTF-16LE by default. Our header parsing didn't enforce/normalize encoding for legacy variants. Fix plan: 1) hotfix to tokenize honoring header (rollback safe), 2) add pre-parse normalization in gateway, 3) add test coverage and a monitoring signal for encoding mismatches.

raj.suresh: Hotfix branch opened: `hotfix/token-encoding-1941`. CI queued. If green, will push canary to a single ded node in 15m, then roll.

mei (oncall): Handoff note for next on-call (raj takes night shift): we've applied routing fallback (bytepair-compat), soft cap set, customer notified, billing team paused invoices for spike window, hotfix in CI. Current impact: token counts reduced but still above baseline ~2x; customer traffic healthy.

raj.suresh: I'll take over after 22:45 PST. Please @me if the CI fails or customer reopens ticket.

cs-liaison: Customer asks for a temporary credit for the spike period — can billing confirm?

ben (billing): We can issue a one-time credit equivalent to the estimated overage for the 10m spike if engineering confirms it was due to SDK encoding change. I'll hold action until postmortem.

ops-bot: incident-bot: Severity set to P2 (customer impact: elevated billing risk, degraded unit economics). Incident channel: private incident room created.

mei (oncall): Quick snippet to detect similar incidents programmatically: 
```
# find tenants with >3x token/baseline in last 10m and header mismatch
opsctl query anomalies --window 10m --metric tokens_per_req --threshold 3 --filter "header:X-encoding!=u8"
```

elena (eng-ml): After routing and soft cap, measured token-per-request for sierrasys-prod: before=14,520; after routing=1,720; baseline=800. So mitigation worked but we still want the hotfix in prod.

raj.suresh: CI passed. I'm going to canary the tokenizer fix to ded-s-02 node-7 now. Rolling to canary...

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy of hotfix/token-encoding-1941 to ded-s-02/node-7 started by raj.suresh at 2026-03-15T22:10:12Z.

sam (eng-runtime): Canary metrics look good — token-per-req normalized to ~820 for sampled traffic. No increase in latency.

raj.suresh: Rolling hotfix to remaining nodes in ded-s-02. ETA 8m.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout complete. All nodes in ded-s-02 now running hotfix/token-encoding-1941.

mei (oncall): Great. Please keep routing in place for 1h as precaution, then we can remove and rely on fix. Customer already informed.

cs-liaison: Customer confirmed token counts look normal in their dashboard after canary. They asked for final confirmation before we remove fallback routing.

ben (billing): I'll prepare a billing statement proposing a credit for the spike window, pending incident postmortem.

mei (oncall): Closing loop: mitigation = routing fallback + soft cap + tokenizer hotfix rolled. Handing incident fully to raj for overnight monitoring and postmortem writeup. If anything changes ping @channel. :white_check_mark:

raj.suresh: Taking over. I'll draft the postmortem and link ticket to CS. Thanks all.

ops-bot: incident-bot: Incident status changed to MITIGATED by raj.suresh at 2026-03-15T23:00:01Z.
